pairs.question: According to the AFH Chapter 15 flight training outline, which of the following are components of the preflight inspection's oxygen system functional test?
pairs.answer: Verification of oxygen supply and pressure
pairs.source: AFH Chapter 15, Section 15.11 – Flight Training: Preflight Inspection item 3a lists the functional test of the oxygen system as including verification of supply and pressure, regulator operation, oxygen flow, mask fit, and pilot and ATC communication using mask microphones.
